items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: Bill Gates wasn’t shy either. He seems like an android but he can’t be but so much an android getting to where he is.

ctx.x: No one ever accused you of being shy.
You don’t get nowhere like that. Bill Gates wasn’t shy either. He seems like an android but he can’t be but so much an android getting to where he is. He was under the radar.
